patch_description: Builds on the highest-scoring seed (single shared rotation parameter for both pre- and post-entanglement layers, giving only 1 unique trainable parameter) and enriches the fixed entangling structure with a zero-parameter "dual-ring" topology: a nearest-neighbor CZ ring plus a skip-2 CZ ring layered on top. This adds non-local connectivity (each qubit now entangles with its immediate neighbor and its second neighbor) without increasing the parameter count, aiming to improve expressivity/generalization and potentially speed up convergence while preserving the extreme parameter economy (n_params stays minimal) that drove the best prior score.
